milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must navigate near the white stained glass wall (centered at ~8, ~1, ~3 relative to spawn) and face it to demonstrate they've found it. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because crafting white stained glass in a 3x2 pattern produces white_stained_glass_pane items that end up in the player's inventory. CommonSenseAgent confirmed that white_stained_glass crafts into white_stained_glass_pane (not regular glass_pane). Checking for min_count=1 since the recipe yields 16 but we only need to confirm crafting occurred.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must navigate near the stone brick wall landmark (centered at ~13, ~1, ~8 relative to spawn) and face it. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_concrete_powder drops the block as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. Red concrete powder drops itself when mined (no special tool required). Checking min_count=1 to confirm at least one block was successfully mined and collected.
